_comment: W2-C scoring of the O7 T_15 (640 poles) audit explain texts on vast.ai, prepared for the case that AWS g6e capacity is still absent (none since 2026-10-20 08:48 UTC). Same job module and step as the AWS lane (infra/aws_pg/steps/neurons_w2c_o7_probe.json, d5b8177e) with every S3 input rewritten to the mirror results/mdl/neurons/... because the box user reads only results/mdl/*; the coordinator mirrors the inputs server-side and uploads the rewritten steps.json, and copies the outputs back to results/neurons/w2c/o7_probe/1/out/. pg_git_sha names 17057bd0, which holds the shipped code (probe rule 62d865d3, pipeline_job e4278745); the commit that adds this manifest changes nothing else under infra/. Weights: allenai/Olmo-3-1025-7B stage1-step1413814 (14.6 GB) is not in the S3 cache; the job downloads it in-run (--revision) into HF_HUB_CACHE and deletes it after the harvest, as on AWS. weights_mode download with no weights_hf_repo makes lifecycle.sh skip its own download block and makes the offer filter require inet_down>=800; HF_ONLINE=1 lifts the image's offline env and HF_TOKEN comes from controller.py, so hf_online_setup() never calls SSM.
